After subtracting lower-order arithmetic terms, the plotted numerical results are reported as consistent with this breakpoint and plateau.
accepted_interpretation.speculation_status: Numerical consistency after a lower-order correction is not proof of a phase transition or of the zeta/freezing correspondence. The extracted figure lacks precise plotting data, and the subtraction introduces an additional modeling dependency. The qualitative critical point, high-temperature curve, plateau, and reported agreement are readable. Exact data values, normalization details, and the arithmetic renormalization require the original figure or scan. Interpreting the plateau as dominance by the deepest landscape values and as a thermodynamic response test complementary to maxima is faithful to the freezing framing. Bibliography and figure debris are interleaved, but the qualitative breakpoint, plateau, and reported agreement are readable; exact plot values require the scan.
